caption: Without a plan a search for yoga mat returns products with stock and processing time, but every card says Subscribe to See Price and the research filters are greyed out. The account name is hidden.
The product page is locked the same way: no supplier price, Add to Cart greyed out. Add to Inventory List is the button that opens the trial window. The account name is hidden.

Add to Inventory List opened a $0.99 trial for Basic, billed quarterly, that renews at US$170.99 a quarter after 7 days. No tax or fee line showed before a payment method. We filled in nothing and closed it.

With the quarterly tab selected: Limited $28.67, Basic $57.00 and Standard $142.67 a month, billed per quarter. Only Basic and Standard offer the $0.99 trial; Enterprise is monthly or annual only. The account name is hidden.

Doba Pilot on the free credits, with no card, returned three yoga mats with supplier prices (US$ 14.72 to US$ 33.67), fulfillment and refund rates in about 1 minute 45 seconds. The account avatar is hidden.
Our second question cost a credit (28 left), but Pilot said it cannot add a product to an inventory list and offered a bookmark or its own memory instead. The account avatar is hidden.
